plans.idea: Classic leaderboard: one wide full-height text column on the left reads headline then steps, with the white CTA pill anchored at the right and the legal tucked as a small caption under it.
Three left-to-right columns: the copy column takes most of the width, a narrow quiet legal column sits between it and the CTA, so the eye travels message to fine print to action without stacking.
Two-row left block with a full-height CTA on the right: copy fills the upper band, the legal runs as a thin footer line along the bottom of that block, and the CTA is centred on the right edge.
